nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in constructor and used by the onlyOwner access-control gate.
Pending owner address; written in transferOwnership and consumed/reset in acceptOwnership.
Token symbol set to FFM in the TokenBEP20 constructor.
Token name set in the TokenBEP20 constructor.
Token decimals, set to 0 in the constructor.
Total supply of the token (100000000) minted to owner at construction.
Special blocked/locked address controlled by the owner; enforced in transfer/transferFrom and mutated implicitly in transferFrom.
Mapping of token balances; mutated on transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf and totalSupply.
Nested allowance mapping; mutated by approve/approveAndCall and decremented in transferFrom.
onlyOwner function that stages a pending owner in newOwner.
Permissionless function that promotes newOwner to owner if msg.sender equals newOwner, then zeroes newOwner.
Deploys the token, sets metadata and mints the whole supply to owner (msg.sender).
onlyOwner function that sets the blocked/locked address newun.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.sub.
Public view returning the balances mapping entry for an address.
Token transfer; requires recipient != newun and updates balances with SafeMath add/sub.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to the supplied amount without any restriction.
Spends an allowance and moves tokens; also silently sets newun = to when newun is zero and from is non-zero.
Public view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance and then makes an external call into the spender contract via receiveApproval.
Payable fallback of TokenBEP20 that unconditionally reverts.
onlyOwner function that transfers the entire contract ETH balance to msg.sender.
Payable fallback of FFM that accepts ETH without logic.
Untrusted caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits, allowance keys and ETH payout destination.
balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens) arithmetic operation inside transfer.
balances[to].add(tokens) arithmetic operation inside transfer.
balances[from].sub(tokens) and allowed[from][msg.sender].sub(tokens) arithmetic inside transferFrom.
balances[to].add(tokens) arithmetic operation inside transferFrom.
_totalSupply.sub(balances[address(0)]) arithmetic operation inside totalSupply.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, address(this), data) executed after state writes.
_owner.transfer(address(this).balance) external ETH payout to msg.sender draining the contract balance.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership, stored into newOwner.
Parameter tokenOwner used as the mapping key in balanceOf and allowance.
Parameter spender used as allowance key and as the callee address in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens: amount used by transfer, transferFrom, approve and approveAndCall.
Parameter to: destination address in transfer and transferFrom.
Parameter from: source address debited in transferFrom.
Parameter _newun: new blocked address written to the newun state variable.
Parameter data: arbitrary bytes forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
Local payable variable _owner in clearCNDAO assigned from msg.sender and used as ETH transfer recipient.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the debited balance key in transfer.
msg.sender is the owner key of allowed in approve.
msg.sender is used as allowance spender key and branch condition in transferFrom.
msg.sender is stored as allowance owner and passed as from to receiveApproval.
onlyOwner gate requires msg.sender == owner before writing newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting ownership.
clearCNDAO is guarded by onlyOwner and msg.sender becomes the ETH recipient.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints supply to that address.
msg.sender flows into the identity of the recipient of the whole ETH balance.
owner is compared with msg.sender in the onlyOwner modifier of transferOwnership.
owner is emitted and then overwritten with newOwner in acceptOwnership.
newOwner is the required caller and the new owner value in acceptOwnership.
balances[owner] is credited with the total supply in the constructor.
balances mapping is read and written by transfer.
balances mapping is read and written by transferFrom.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
transfer requires to != newun, making the blocked address part of the transfer logic.
transferFrom reads and implicitly assigns newun, controlling which recipients are blocked.
transfernewun writes the owner-controlled newun variable.
tokens amount parameter is subtracted from and added to balances in transfer.
to parameter is the credited destination and the newun comparison target in transfer.
tokens amount parameter drives the SafeMath sub/add operations in transferFrom.
from parameter is the debited address and allowance owner in transferFrom.
tokens amount is written into the allowed mapping in approve.
spender is the second key of allowed in approve.
spender is cast to ApproveAndCallFallBack and externally called, enabling callback reentrancy.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenOwner is the lookup key in balanceOf.
tokenOwner is the first lookup key in allowance.
_newOwner is written into the privileged newOwner state variable.
_newun is written into the owner-controlled newun state variable.
Local _owner (from msg.sender) is the recipient of the full contract balance transfer.
transfer executes SafeMath.sub on the caller balance.
transfer executes SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
transferFrom executes SafeMath.sub on balance and allowance.
transferFrom executes SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
totalSupply executes _totalSupply.sub(balances[address(0)]).
approveAndCall reaches the external receiveApproval call after updating allowance state.
clearCNDAO reaches the privileged ETH payout of the contract balance.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter approveAndCall / transferFrom before state is fully settled.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter only exists to feed the privileged transferOwnership write and carries no independent semantics.
tokenOwner is a pure lookup key for the balances mapping read in balanceOf.
spender is only a mapping key/callee argument for the approve-family entry points.
tokens is the amount consumed by the transfer arithmetic and allowance writes.
to is the destination address for the balance credit and the newun comparison.
from is the debited address and allowance owner inside transferFrom.
_newun is a raw argument that only feeds the owner-controlled newun state variable.
data is opaque calldata forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Local _owner is only the payable recipient of the balance transfer, so it collapses into the unsafe ETH payout operation.
